feed.title: Board of Assessors — Lunenburg Budget Project
feed.subtitle: When an agenda is posted or changed, and when a meeting’s recording, transcript and our minutes are all in.

entry.title: Board of Assessors: the meeting of 4 November 2026 — recording, transcript and our minutes
entry.summary: Assessors reviewed tax classification hearing prep and went into executive session on senior and veterans exemptions. The recording is on the town’s channel (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4K1dJIblfEc), its captions are searchable, and our minutes are written from them; the video at its timestamp is the record.
